title: Unit representatives of terminal inverse-image sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J a small cofiltered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and D : J → X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] have affine terms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] open over X [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let c be its underlying scheme limit cone and p : c.pt → X satisfy c_j ≫ D(j).hom = p. For any left adjoint H to p_* [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], abelian étale sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and t ∈ H(F)(T), where T is the terminal étale object of c.pt, there exist an arbitrary étale X-object U, a map ψ : T → p^*U [def-pc-fibre-product], and b ∈ F(U) such that restriction along ψ of the adjunction unit applied to b equals t. U is not required to be a term of D, and no factorization of ψ through a term is asserted.

source.place: Inverse-image construction and adjunction; affine étale continuity Tag 0EYL; degree-zero Tag 03Q6 steps (1)-(3)

proof.text: Obtain a finite affine stage covering with local sections whose inverse-image unit images are the restrictions of t. Pass to a later covering refinement on which their restricted sections are compatible. Neither step selects a global amalgamation.

Forget F to its sheaf of sets. Presheaf.IsSheaf.existsUnique_amalgamation_ofArrows glues the compatible restricted sections to z on D(k), with the specified restriction equations. The cone projection gives σ:T→p*D(k). As D(k).hom is an open monomorphism, its pullback structure map is mono; canceling it shows π′_b followed by σ equals p*(v′_b). Unit naturality along v′_b and γ_b, the amalgamation equations, and the refinement equations show that restricting the unit image of z along σ agrees with t on each π′_b. Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext_ofArrows proves global equality. Return U=D(k), ψ=σ, b=z. The actual Lean gluing, monomorphism cancellation and unit calculations are complete.

proof_origin.place: Finite local representatives and eventual overlap agreement, followed by Lean sheaf gluing and unit naturality; W4 stage-3 reduction

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpenSections_inverse_image_unit_representatives
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale)
    [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : (H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)))) :
    ∃ (U : X.Etale) (ψ : Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt) ⟶ p.Etale.obj U)
      (b : F.obj.obj (op U)),
      (H.obj F).obj.map ψ.op ((hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op U) b) = t
